liveness.means: the Space process answers HTTP; /api/ready checks PostgreSQL and reports degraded dependencies

drains: subscription retries stop; the HTTP server stops accepting requests and gives in-flight requests up to 4 seconds
the Discord relay and Events outbox finish their current sends; unsent rows remain for the next start
the PostgreSQL pool closes and the process exits
shutdown.note: server/index.js uses openvibe-sdk/service gracefulStop with a 4-second drain and 5-second deadline

resumes.what: unsent space.* events in the PostgreSQL outbox relay after restart (at least once)
Events subscriptions are recreated and pending network and VIP deliveries are retried idempotently
the Roadmap space resyncs from docs/roadmap/public.json and Discord relay workers restart

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy restores the prior sha if /api/ready fails in its readiness window
rollback.window: automatic during deploy readiness; manual afterwards while the previous code is database compatible

blockers.none: the initial PostgreSQL migration creates the Space schema without dropping earlier data

leases.none: PostgreSQL outbox workers coordinate delivery; no separate service-owned lease is exposed

notes: Space owns forum spaces, threads, posts, votes, categories, reactions, moderation and the Discord relay in its PostgreSQL database. OpenVibe.Community retains pastes, comments, Pulse and submissions; legacy /s/* pages redirect permanently to openvibe.space.
